mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (using 2019-08-15 data as reference point).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (using historical data from 2000-2019).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline (monthly change < 0)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (using 2019-08-15 data as reference point).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of slowing industrial production (INDPRO below 105.0), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0 (using 2019-08-15 data as reference point).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is above 150,000 (thousands).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index above 0.25% (CPIAUCSL monthly change) signals rising inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a contraction in both the housing sector and manufacturing, reducing overall economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline (monthly change < 0)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0.
